name: terminal-normal
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"
ahdl_include "support_cmp.va"

Vvdd (vdd 0) vsource dc=0.9
Vvss (vss 0) vsource dc=0.0
Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 delay=1.4n period=5.7n width=2.5n rise=60p fall=60p
Vvinp (vinp 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.4746 5.8n 0.4746 6n 0.4377 11.8n 0.4377 12n 0.45492 17.8n 0.45492 18n 0.446925 23.8n 0.446925 24n 0.46845]
Vvinn (vinn 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.4254 5.8n 0.4254 6n 0.4623 11.8n 0.4623 12n 0.44508 17.8n 0.44508 18n 0.453075 23.8n 0.453075 24n 0.43155]
XCMP (vdd vss clk vinp vinn outp outn) support_overdrive_delay_comparator td_0=160p td_max=480p
XMEAS (vdd vss clk vinp vinn outp outn delay_ps overdrive_mv polarity valid) delay_meter

tran tran stop=29n maxstep=1p
save clk vinp vinn outp outn delay_ps overdrive_mv polarity valid
